about.title: About us
content: PaxTech is a startup led by students from Universidad Peruana de Ciencias Aplicadas, dedicated to developing innovative technological solutions.
In a world where digitalization is key to success, PaxTech empowers beauty professionals with an intuitive and automated platform that improves the experience for both them and their clients.
Through our solution, we seek to revolutionize the way stylists organize their schedule, reducing time loss and increasing their visibility in the market.
